description: This file contains utility functions for extracting Android build system variables, specifically including a function to locate the Android build top directory by traversing parent directories looking for a specific marker.

methods.name: find_android_build_top(path)
methods.description: Locates the top directory of the Android build system by searching up the directory hierarchy for a marker directory and file.

parameters.name: path
parameters.description: The starting path from which to search upwards.
